verdict.rationale: gstack ships skills that run multi-step work autonomously once invoked. /autoplan chains the CEO, design, eng and DX reviews with auto-decisions, /qa iteratively fixes and commits bugs, and /ship runs the full merge-test-PR pipeline. A community user also describes letting agents run autonomously across repos. However, these are user-invoked, in-session workflows. The only background components are a persistent headless browser daemon and end-of-session learning logs, which are not user-defined automations. Missing for 10: user-configurable automations, scheduled or event-triggered runs, true background execution outside an interactive agent session, and hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.
